tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (shrī)༄༅/ /bsngo smon bkra shis byin rlabs can gyi skor rnams bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni skye zhi
(shrī)༄༅/ /bsngo smon bkra shis byin rlabs can gyi skor rnams bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni skye zhi

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// bsngo smon bkra shis byin rlabs can gyi skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob gyur nas// bshes gnyen dam pa rnams dang mjal ba dang*// rtag tu dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog /srid pa'i bde la nam yang ma chags shing*// myang 'das dman pa'i mtha' la'ang ma zhen par// mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bla med byang chub sgrub la brtson par shog /don dam spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba dang*// kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur rtogs gyur nas// skad cig tsam yang g.yel ba med par ni// zab don nyams su len la brtson par shog /tshe 'di nyid la'ang mi dge kun spong zhing*// rtag tu dge ba'i chos la rab tu brtson// dus rnams rtag tu sgo gsum spyod pa rnams// gzhan la phan pa'i don du 'gyur bar shog /tshe'i 'du byed gtong bar gyur pa na// nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// dad dang 'dun pa'i shugs kyis legs bgrod nas// 'od dpag med pa'i thugs rjes rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa'i smon lam 'di dpon rin chen bzang po'i don du chos smra ba'i btsun pa thogs med kyis dngul chu'i chos rdzong du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i rdo rje'i gsung nad kyi 'jigs pa zhi ba'i gsol 'debs sa skya nad grol ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// las dang glo bur rkyen las gyur pa yi// gdon dang nad dang 'byung po'i 'tshe ba sogs// sems can yid mi bde ba'i nad rnams kun// 'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /ji ltar gshed mas khrid pa'i gsad bya bzhin// skad cig gcig la lus sems 'bral byed pa'i// srog 'phrog nad kyi sdug bsngal ji snyed pa// 'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha nang chud pa ltar// nad kyi ming tsam thos pas skrag byed pa'i// nyin gcig pa dang rtag pa'i rims sogs kyis// lus can kun la gnod par ma gyur cig

/gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*// glo bur ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu dang*// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad la sogs pa yis// lus can kun la 'tshe bar ma gyur cig /lus sems bde ba ma lus 'phrog byed pa'i// 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i sdug bsngal ji snyed pa// ma lus zhi zhing mdangs stobs ldan pa dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i nus mthu dang*// las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyis// bsngo ba smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar rgya nad mig ser/ bal nad rgyu gzer/ ha la lcog 'gyel/ 'dzu ma ltag dgyed sogs nag po sum 'khril 'bab lugs sna tshogs pas mi rnams bza' btung dang las ka byed 'phro la 'chi zhing*/ dran pas mi zin par mchong rgyug smra brjod sna tshogs pa'i ngang nas 'chi ba sogs la mdos dang gtor zlog bon po'i rim gro/ sman pa dang sngags pa'i srung ba sogs gang gis kyang ma phan par gdan sa chen po stongs pa la thug pa'i skabs/ bu chen shākya dpal bzang dpon slob brgyad la/ grub thob chen po'i sku/ bkra shis sgo mang bka' shog dang bcas pa gnang*/ snga ma slebs nas rims chug sgo gcig kyang ma las par tshogs 'khor shoms/ ma nam mkha' ma'i skyabs 'gro gyis/ ma ṇi sgrongs/ smon lam 'di thob gsungs nas gnang ba bka' bzhin du bsgrubs pas nad rims 'phral du chad cing bde skyid dang ldan par gyur pa'i rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i rdo rje'i gsung mtshon gyi 'jigs pa zhi ba'i bden tshig bzhugs so// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ byams chen rgyal ba 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// khro rgyal rta mgrin rje btsun sgrol ma sogs// mtshan tsam thos pas 'jigs pa kun sel ba'i// skyabs gnas thugs rje'i bdag nyid dgongs su gsol// rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can rnams// las ngan phrag dog mtsho chen rdol ba las// 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba na// ye shes thugs rje'i zhugs kyis skem par mdzod// zhe sdang me phung 'bar ba'i 'gro ba la// byams pa'i bdud rtsi'i char chen phab nas kyang*// phan tshun pha ma lta bu'i 'du shes kyis// bde skyid bkra shis 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// gang gi rgyud la zhugs pas skad cig gis// blo sna lha min bzhin du sgyur byed pa// 'byung po gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas// phyin chad phyogs 'dir rgyu bar ma gyur cig

/g.yul ngor shi ba'i sems can thams cad kyang*// deng nas las ngan rgyu 'bras kun spong zhing*// bde ba can du rdzus te skyes nas kyang*// thams cad zhing der 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// skye rgu thams cad tshe ring nad med cing*// 'thab rtsod kun zhi dge ba bcu la spyod// char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs// snod bcud bkra shis 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// chos nyid rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang*// chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa dang*// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog thugs rje yis// rnam dag smon lam rgya cher 'grub par shog /ces mdo khams me nyag gi yul du g.yul 'khrugs rgyun mi chad pa sus kyang 'dums pa ma nus pa'i tshe/ rje grub thob chen po phyogs der phebs nas thugs bskyed mdzad/ bden tshigs gsungs shing me tog 'thor ba tsam gyis thams cad kyi phrag dog dang zhe sdang gi gdug sems thams cad zhi zhing g.yul 'khrugs rgyun chad/ lo legs skya rgyal sogs bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa byung ba'i rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gsung mu ge'i 'jigs pa zhi ba'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// mtha' yas 'gro ba nges par sgrol slad du// bla med byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad rgyal ba thugs rje can/

'di nas tshig rkang gsum zhal skong*/ /phyogs bcu'i rnam 'dren byang sems nyan rang dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs// gnod sbyin nor lha gter bdag 'khor dang bcas// mgon med snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtser dgongs nas// bkres skom nyam thag sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// lus can 'di dag nges par bskyab phyir du// rin chen zas nor 'bru dang mal cha sogs// yid 'ong mkho rgu'i longs spyod ji snyed kyi// char pa 'dzam gling kha ba can du phob// dus min rlung dang me than char chu sogs// 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa nye bar zhi ba dang*// 'bru bcud rtsi thog lo tog la sogs pa// rdzogs ldan dus ltar smin cing rgyas gyur cig /byams dang snying rje'i shugs kyis rab bskul nas// rgya chen smon lam btab pa 'di yi mthus// nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa nyer zhi nas// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang*// las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// 'gro kun bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces dbus gtsang du lo nyes sad ser sogs kyis mu ge'i 'jigs pa chen po byung ba'i dus/ rje grub thob chen pos lha ldan jo bo rin po che'i mdun du gser gyi lhung bzed 'brus bkang ba phul zhing thugs smon mdzad pas/ gang zag las can rnams kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis nam mkha' nas bod yul du 'bru'i char pa 'bebs pa mthong zhing*/ 'gro ba thams cad bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal las dgrol bar mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i rdo rje'i gsung smon lam yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs// dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa yi// mchod pa rgya chen bzhes nas kyang*// 'gro ba rnams kyi don slad du// smon lam 'grub par mdzad du gsol// bdag ni ma rig rmongs pa yis// sdig pa'i las ni ci bgyis pa// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la bshags// ngan 'gro'i g.yang las bsgral du gsol// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal skye bo yi// dge ba kun la rab dang ba'i// bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i mgon la 'gro don du// dam chos 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi// sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// ji ltar byang chub sems bskyed cing*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rnams// de dag rim bzhin bgyid pa ltar// de bzhin bdag gis 'gro don du// byang chub sems nyid bskyed par bgyid// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rnams// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba yis// bla med byang chub mchog thob nas// 'gro kun srid mtsho sgrol bar shog

/bdag ni byang chub ma thob bar// lam la bar chad med pa dang*// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs gyur te// sa rab dga' ba ma thob bar// rab tu byung ba thob par shog /dge sbyong chos dang ldan gyur te// rtag tu 'phags pa'i rigs ldan nas// tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par shog /lus dang srog la mi blta bar// bshes gnyen dam pa bsten byed cing*// 'phags pa'i nor bdun ldan pa yis// rtag tu dam pa'i chos 'dzin shog /sdom pa gsum la rab gnas shing*// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /rtag tu dkon mchog mchod byed cing*// rtag tu bla ma mnyes byed shog /lan dang rnam smin mi re ba'i// phyogs med sbyin pa gtong bar byed// zhe 'dod tshul 'chos med pa yis// dri med tshul khrims bsrung bar shog /mi mthun yul la sran tshugs pa'i// rtag tu bzod la gnas par shog /sems can don la rab spro ba'i// go cha brtson 'grus brtan par shog /phyi nang 'du 'dzis mi gnod pa'i// rtse gcig sems la dbang thob shog /chos rnams stong zhing bdag med pas// lhag mthong shes rab mchog thob shog /rang sems skye ba med pa'i don// cig char rtogs pa 'char bar shog /sems la brtan pa ma thob bar// ri dwags bzhin du 'jigs med par// gcig pur ri khrod gnas bcas shing*// snang sems kun la dbang thob shog /lus ngag sems la mi gnod cing*// mtshan ma'i spros pas ma gos pa'i// dmigs pa med pa'i ye shes kyis// 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyis// gzhan don phun sum tshogs par shog /gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// mi dge sdig sbyong ji snyed pa// dge ba'i bsod nams ldan par shog /las ngan rnam par smin pa yis// ngan song sdug bsngal ji snyed pa// de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyis// mtho ris bde ba thob par shog /gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// sems can nad pa ji snyed pa// de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyis// nad med dga' ba thob par shog

/gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// long ba rnams kyis gzugs mthong zhing*// 'on pa rnams kyis sgra thos te// smyon pa rnams kyis dran rnyed shog /bkres skom can rnams zas skom rnyed// gos med rnams kyis gos rnyed cing*// phongs pa rnams kyis nor thob shog /'jigs skrag can rnams 'jigs med cing*// bcings pa rnams ni grol bar shog /gang dag 'chi 'pho'i sems can rnams// nad gcong sdug bsngal med par shog /srid pa bar do'i sems can rnams// 'jigs med rang dbang thob par shog /'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis// khro ba'i sems ni dul gyur cig /pha ma bu tsha'i sems ldan pas// phan tshun rtsod pa med par shog /gang dag bdag la dad gus dang*// zas skom sbyin dang mchod bstod pa// de dag dge ba thob gyur cig /byang chub dam pa thob par shog /gang zhig bdag la gdung ba yi// gsol 'debs byin rlabs thogs med shog /gang zhig bdag la gshe ba dang*// khro dang brdeg dang srog gcod sogs// myur du 'gyod pa'i sems skyes nas// bdag gi 'khor gyi thog mar shog /sems can lus dang longs spyod la// bdag gis spyad pa gang yin dang*// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod la// gzhan gyis spyod pa gang yin pa// sems can de dag thams cad kun// bde ba rgya chen thob gyur cig /bdag gis sems can gang dag la// chos dang zang zing sbyin pa dang*// gang gis bdag gi lus dang ngag /mthong thos reg pa'i sems can gang*// lus ngag sgrib pa byang bar shog /gang gis bdag gi ming thos pa// de dag kun gyi lus sems kyi// nad dang sdug bsngal rab zhi nas// bde ba dam pa thob par shog /ji srid nam mkhas gar khyab pa// bdag gi lus kyis khyab gyur te// 'gro kun rang rang 'dod pa yi// gzugs su snang bas don byed shog /de snyed bdag gi ngag gi sgras// khyab cing chos sgra sgrogs par shog /nam mkha' mtha' yas sems can gyi// yid la bdag gi sems zhugs te// stong pa snying rje dbyer med pa'i// byang chub sems dang ldan par shog

/bdag ni sa sogs 'byung chen dang*// legs sbyin nor bu rin chen dang*// dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang*// ma btab lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba// rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa// sems can nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog /bdag gi smon lam stobs dag dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar// 'gro don ji ltar smon pa bzhin// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par shog /ces dpal snar thang pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgyad kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rje grub thob chen pos gnang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can no// ༈ /grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gsung bkra shis byin rlabs can bzhugs so// yin lugs don la skye ba med gyur kyang*// rigs drug ngan 'gro'i skye gnas bsam mi khyab// deng nas 'gro kun skye ba thams cad du// yin lugs skye med rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog /yin lugs don la rgas pa med gyur kyang*// na so 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab// deng nas 'gro kun skye ba thams cad du// yin lugs rgas med rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog /yin lugs don la na ba med gyur kyang*// 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab// deng nas 'gro kun skye ba thams cad du// yin lugs nad med rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog /yin lugs don la 'chi ba med gyur kyang*// sa steng 'di na rtag par sdod dbang med// deng nas 'gro kun skye ba thams cad du// yin lugs 'chi med rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog /nyams dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i bkra shis shog /'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i bkra shis shog /rang la rang phan byed pa'i bkra shis shog /gzhan phan lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po nyid skyi chu la phebs pa'i skabs mnyan pas gru ma btang bar brten/

chu 'gram du khyi lpags bting ba'i steng du/ sku rnam snang gi chos bdun mdzad nas de las ma g.yos bzhin bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs nas chu'i phar ngos su thal gyis phebs/ chu la gnas pa'i sems can grangs med pa skad cig gis grol bar mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs kyi sprin phung 'phro ba'o// ༈ /dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig gnas// sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan// ja bzang bzhes spro rgyun mi chad// skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i gsung byin rlabs can no// //sarba maṅga laṃ// oṃ su pra t-iṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ oṃ sarba bidyā swā hā/ oṃ badzrā ā yu ṣe swā hā// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
